title: Manufacture repeated binary pair coordinates through a Frobenius fixed space
statement: For S=Omega^-1 M sigma, form K=S^d, D=K^(d^-1 mod3), and F=D^-1 S. On the promised class Fix(F) manufactures the hidden binary space and D-stable symplectic planes, with common phase gamma=theta*gamma0*t^3.

requires: Acquired centered contact chart, r>=2,d>=3, invertible Omega/M, common-scalar pair promise and3 not dividing d
Exact field operations and complete coefficient verification
provides: For S=Omega^-1 M sigma, form K=S^d, D=K^(d^-1 mod3), and F=D^-1 S. On the promised class Fix(F) manufactures the hidden binary space and D-stable symplectic planes, with common phase gamma=theta*gamma0*t^3.
assumptions: The basis/fixed-space dimension and full ordinary template are verified, not inferred from sample evaluations

contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; F_(2^d) elements and ordinary field/ring exponents are distinct from Boolean ANF masks. Exact signed/zero counts and source-local phase/rank/depth units.
contract.obstruction: The radial cube scalar cannot be dropped; d divisible by3 does not admit this inverse-mod3 construction.

body: The phase scale cancels from S while radial rescaling remains. The acquired binary changes preserve the two pair types, with the order-three rotation cycling three equivalent square types. A field-type label alone does not certify this cubic template.
